# 🧰 Learning and contribution templates

Use these templates to keep new learning resources consistent. Copy the template into the relevant topic folder and replace all instructional placeholders before committing.

| Template | Use |
|---|---|
| [Lesson notes](lesson-template.md) | Concept explanation and examples |
| [Coding exercise](coding-exercise-template.md) | Programming task with input/output |
| [SQL exercise](sql-exercise-template.md) | Database/SQL practice |
| [QA test case](qa-test-case.md) | Manual test specification |
| [Selenium test case](selenium-test-case.md) | Browser automation case |
| [Assignment brief](assignment-template.md) | Structured assignment instructions |
| [Learning progress](learning-log-template.md) | Personal learning record |

Templates are starting points, not a requirement to add unnecessary paperwork to every short example.
